channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Data Security Triage Agent in IRM Enhancements
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview's Insider Risk Management will enhance the Data Security Triage Agent for better investigation accuracy, affecting security teams. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: [NEW] Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. item.description: [NEW] This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. item.description: [NEW] We've enhanced Flexible Sections in SharePoint Pages to make page layout creation more intuitive and predictable. item.description: [NEW] Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center will be able to apply app and agent installation changes once and have them consistently enforced across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs without compromising on Compliance - while keeping data discoverable and Copilot results highly relevant. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] OneNote mobile for Android will also introduce a summary tool and Q&A feature with Copilot, enhancing information access for users. This affects Android users of OneNote. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), OneNote

item.description: [UPDATED] We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. (GA: January CY2027) — Microsoft Purview

item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] When requesting a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, users can now provide a business justification explaining why they need Copilot. This context is shown to admins during review, helping them make faster, more informed approval decisions and supporting governance and audit needs. Updated July 20, 2026 (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Teams frontline BYOD onboarding wizard
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Simplify frontline onboarding with an improved Teams mobile experience on personal devices. item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Declarative Agents with Actions enable Microsoft 365 Copilot to take real-world actions by invoking APIs, plugins, and enterprise workflows directly within the chat experience. item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Shared & Delegate Mailbox Scheduling for Events
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Empower Chiefs of Staff and delegated roles to efficiently organize events on behalf of leaders or teams using shared or delegated mailboxes. By sending trusted invites from the chosen mailbox, this capability ensures consistent identity, improved trust, and smoother event setup. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Organizers for Teams events instances will now be able to reuse their event configurations in the Events app in Teams. Organizers can save these configurations as a template in the Events app to use again for future Teams events. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] In the Events app in Teams, Teams events organizers will now be able to see if the chosen room or space they have selected for their event is available at the designated time or not. This feature is available for any Teams event organizer with a Teams Enterprise license. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview will enhance the Graph API to include Data Loss Prevention event data, making it easier for customers to integrate with SIEM tools and automate workflows. item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Administrators can now set policies to automatically expire 'People in your organization' sharing links after a specified period, enhancing data governance. This impacts all users sharing internal content. (GA: March CY2026) — OneDrive, SharePoint

item.description: New profile cards for buildings, rooms, and desks will be accessible from Copilot Chat and other Microsoft 365 entry points. This change impacts users interacting with the Places directory. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.description: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. item.description: In Viva Engage, we've simplified how to create posts. The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Minimized meeting window enhancements
item.description: Teams will enhance the minimized meeting window experience, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without restoring the full window. This affects all Teams users during meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Sharing recap access
item.description: In Microsoft Teams, recording and transcript owners can grant access to specific people for recap links without requests. This change affects users who share recordings and transcripts. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Start writing, coding, and creating with Copilot in Pages
item.description: Microsoft Copilot will enable users to co-create content or code in Pages using the tools menu. This affects users working with Copilot in document creation. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)
